start_condition: New Control Tower authorization; Maintainer/Designer/cutover not executed by Groweer
capture_contract: Preserve raw response bytes and SHA, observation time, source publication/availability evidence, retrieval/ingestion time, asOf cutoff, source/schema/calendar/engine/parameter versions.
Log unavailable and revised observations; never relabel R2 as point-in-time. R0 admission only with actual preserved contemporaneous vintage evidence.
Shadow C03 and frozen H1/P1 on identical admitted observations; no product-route wiring or live trades.

evidence_stopping_conditions.stress_branch_coverage: Both absolute-level and joint level/momentum/curve branches must have real admissible observations. Rare subtypes remain unresolved until observed; no calendar timeout converts absence to PASS.
evidence_stopping_conditions.rationale: 100 independent binary adjudications gives worst-case standard error0.5/sqrt(100)=0.05; a rough two-standard-error range is0.10. For60 independent zero-miss events, the one-sided95% binomial upper rate1-0.05**(1/60) is about4.87%. These are planning calculations, not performance guarantees. Serial dependence and clustered stress reduce effective evidence; count distinct episodes and report dependence/sensitivity instead of claiming these bounds blindly.
evidence_stopping_conditions.calendar_duration: Report elapsed calendar span and variety of conditions; do not stop because an arbitrary number of months passed.

adjudication: Predefine contemporaneous semantic questions: broad versus selective participation, genuine level/change disagreement, stale held state, correct missingness. Do not judge by future PnL/returns.
Two independent reviews of raw evidence with candidate names hidden where feasible; record disagreement and rationale, no forced true-regime label.
For each H1 suppression, determine whether omitted information was useful; report all delays and stale risk-on labels, stress exits, first-admissible and missing/gap/version cases.
Measure P1 comprehension versus H1 retention in an separately authorized product study before any UI decision.
For satellites, record actual authorized narrative-block changes, comprehension and missingness; current sign proxies do not establish narrative utility.
promotion_gate: No stress-entry delay or missing-data masking; demonstrated semantic benefit and acceptable independently adjudicated delay cost with all relevant failure modes. If unmet, retain C03 and park challengers. Require Control Tower approval for any methodology change.
cross_asset_reopening: Admitted licensed data with fixed field basis and vintages, paired eligible dates, explicit economic role distinct from equity/implied-vol lineage, and ablation against C03 before proposing a new core family.
PFL_reopening: Explicit portfolio/universe/weights and fixed minimum windows; same-family diagnostics only unless independent economic parents are demonstrated. Never import fragilityScore wholesale.
